testcase.name: Scenario: Reorder an active drawing tab: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:179:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reorder an active drawing tab ✔ Given a drawing and several other documents are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the drawing is active and its tab is visible ✔ When the user drags the drawing tab left across several neighboring tabs ✔ Then the drawing tab appears at its new position among the document tabs ✔ And the drawing remains active ✔ And its sheet and browser remain displayed ✔ When the user drags the drawing tab back to its earlier position ✔ Then the drawing tab returns to its earlier position ✔ And the drawing remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Reorder an inactive part tab: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:189:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reorder an inactive part tab ✔ Given a drawing and several parts are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the drawing is active ✔ And an inactive part tab is visible ✔ When the user drags the inactive part tab left across several neighboring tabs ✔ Then the part tab appears at its new position among the document tabs ✔ And the part becomes active ✔ And the part viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ And the drawing remains open
